scholarships.description: The LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship is a merit-cum-means scheme launched by the Life Insurance Corporation of India to support students from economically weaker sections (EWS) in continuing their education after Class 10 or 12. It aims to reduce financial barriers and encourage higher education in fields such as Medical, Engineering, General Graduation, Diploma, ITI, and Vocational courses
scholarships.name: LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship

scholarships.description: The HDFC Bank Parivartan ECSS Scholarship 2026 offers financial aid up to ₹75,000 for students from Class 1 to postgraduate studies facing financial difficulties. A student can avail this scholarship for a maximum of 2 consecutive academic year .
scholarships.name: HDFC Parivartan ECSS Scholarship

scholarships.description: The Foundation For Excellence (FFE) Scholarship 2026 is designed to assist bright students from low-income families who have excelled in state or national level entrance exams. It is a merit- and need-based program that provides not only financial support but also long-term mentorship and career guidance to help students succeed professionally and academically
scholarships.minMarks: Admission through a merit based entrance examination and require 70% or higher marks in 12th
scholarships.name: Foundation For Excellence Scholarship

scholarships.minMarks: No criteria of marks (Generally recommended by staff advisor)
scholarships.name: CEETAT Scholarship

scholarships.description:
The Scheme is being implemented by AICTE to provide encouragement and support to orphans, wards of parents 
died due to Covid-19, wards of Armed Forces and Central Paramilitary Forces martyred in action (Shaheed) to 
pursue education. This is an attempt to give every such child, an opportunity to study further and prepare for a 
successful future through education in AICTE Approved institutions and courses.
scholarships.minMarks: There is no fixed min mark. Selection is based on merit (class 12th marks)
scholarships.name: AICTE Swanath Scholarship

scholarships.description: Scholarship/Contingency is awarded to Differently abled students taking admission in AICTE approved Technical institution at Degree/ Diploma. Scholarship given @ Rs 50000 as incidentals each year.
scholarships.minMarks: Differently abled students having disability of not less than 40%.
scholarships.name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship

scholarships.description:
Scheme being implemented by AICTE aimed at providing assistance for advancement of 
Girls pursuing technical education. Education is one of the most important means of 
empowering women with the knowledge, skill and self-confidence necessary to participate 
fully in the development process. This is an attempt to give young women the opportunity to 
further her education and prepare for a successful future by “Empowering Women through 
Technical Education”
scholarships.minMarks: Female students admitted to 1st year or 2nd year (lateral entry) of AICTE-approved institutions
scholarships.name: AICTE Pragathi Scholarship

scholarships.description: Students with a household income of under Rs. 15 lakh who are enrolled in first year (academic year 2025-26) of their undergraduate studies pursuing any subject stream can apply. The programme will also aim to encourage applications by girls and specially-abled students. Selected scholars will receive a scholarship of up to 2 lakhs over the duration of their degree programme. In addition to the scholarship grant, the Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships will provide scholars an opportunity to be part of a vibrant alumni network and an enabling support system that will create a long-term impact on their lives and career trajectories.
scholarships.name: Reliance Foundation Scholarship

scholarships.description: The Siemens Scholarship Program is a four-year initiative supporting economically disadvantaged first-year engineering students in India with financial aid, mentorship, internships, and industry-aligned training.
scholarships.minMarks: 40% in the entrance exam and 60% in class 12
scholarships.name: Siemens Scholarship

scholarships.description: The SBI Platinum Jubilee Asha Scholarship 2025-26, launched by SBI Foundation, is one of India’s largest scholarship initiatives designed to empower meritorious students from economically weaker backgrounds. The program ensures that financial challenges do not hinder access to quality education, supporting students across multiple levels and disciplines.
scholarships.minMarks: 75% for plus two + min CGPA 7.0 for other years
scholarships.name: SBI Asha

scholarships.description: The Sitaram Jindal Scholarship, administered by the Sitaram Jindal Foundation (SJF) in Bengaluru, is designed to support financially disadvantaged yet meritorious students. It covers students pursuing education from Class 11 up to postgraduate degrees, including ITI, diploma, engineering, medical, and other technical courses. The scholarship is open to students from all categories—General, OBC, SC, ST, and minority communities—and is available for students in government, government-aided, and private institutions that do not charge exorbitant fees .
scholarships.name: Sitaram Jindal Foundation Scholarship

scholarships.description: Dr. Nidhi Kadir Watson Memorial Scholarship is established by Nidhi Kadir Watson Program, here in after called NKW Program, formed by Nidhi’s parents Kadirpillai Chollampattu and Tara Fatima. The Program is offering scholarships for students in Kerala to pursue studies leading to a Bachelors degree in the fields of engineering/ medicine/technology / computer science / architecture / naval-architecture / arts or general science. Scholarships will be awarded for four years of study in engineering or medicine. For others, depending on duration of the course.
scholarships.minMarks: First 2000 rank and above 90% in plus two
scholarships.name: Nidhi Kadhir Watson (NKW) Scholarship

scholarships.description: The Anandam Senapathy Scholarship, instituted by Pratiksha Trust, supports economically underprivileged yet meritorious students from Kerala pursuing MBBS and B.Tech courses. Since its inception, the scholarship has supported over 1,200 students, with 200 current scholars pursuing their dreams of becoming engineers and doctors.
scholarships.minMarks: 80% for Plus 2 examination and a good rank for NEET/KEAM exam
scholarships.name: Pratiksha Trust Anandam Senapathy Scholarship

scholarships.description: The Vidya Samunnathi Scholarship is a financial assistance program initiated by the Kerala State Welfare Corporation for Forward Communities Ltd (KSWCFC). It is designed to support students from economically backward families within the non-reservation (forward) communities of Kerala to pursue education from high school through postgraduate levels, including professional and national-level institutions.
scholarships.name: Vidya Sammunathi Scholarship

scholarships.description: A prestigious, merit-based scholarship offered by the R.P. Foundation in partnership with NORKA Roots, providing significant financial assistance and long-term academic support to economically disadvantaged students pursuing higher education.
scholarships.name: Ravi pillai Foundation (Norka Roots) Scholarship

scholarships.description: The MACEAA HOPE Plus Scholarship 2025–26, offered by the MACEA Galaxy Charitable Trust, provides up to ₹40,000 per year to financially challenged but academically strong students of the College of Engineering Trivandrum (MACE). Applications are open for 1st-year B.Tech and B.Arch students
scholarships.name: MACEAA Hope Plus Scholarship

scholarships.description: The MACEAA GEMS (Growing Engineers’ Monetary Support) Scholarship 2026 is offered by the College of Engineering Trivandrum Alumni Association (MACEAA) to support financially needy but meritorious students. It provides ₹10,000 per year
scholarships.name: MACEAA GEMS Scholarship

scholarships.description: The Kind Circle Scholarship for Meritorious Students 2026–27 is a private, need-based program supporting students from Class 1 up to postgraduate level in India, offering a minimum of ₹6,000 and more depending on financial need. Applications are open until 31 March 2027.
scholarships.minMarks: At least 60% marks in the previous academic year
scholarships.name: Kind Circle Scholarship

scholarships.description: The ONGC Scholarship offers ₹48,000 per year (₹4,000 per month) to 2,000 meritorious students from SC, ST, OBC, and General (EWS) categories pursuing Engineering, MBBS, MBA, or Master’s in Geology/Geophysics. Half of the scholarships are reserved for girl students
scholarships.minMarks: At least 60% marks in the previous academic year
scholarships.name: ONGC Scholarship

scholarships.description: The Malayalee Engineers Association (MEA) Scholarship 2026 is a financial aid program funded by Malayalee engineers in Houston, USA. It provides $600 per year (≈₹50,000) for four years to academically strong but financially needy undergraduate engineering students in Kerala.
scholarships.minMarks: Scored above 85% marks in Class X and XII examinations                                                  Ranked within the top 7000 in the Govt. of Kerala Engineering Entrance Examination (KEAM Rank).                                                                                                                   National Aptitude Test in Architecture (NATA) score greater than 110 (For B. Arch students)
scholarships.name: Malayalee Engineer's Association (MEA) Scholarship

scholarships.description: Fisheries e‑Grantz is Kerala’s dedicated scholarship system for the children of registered fishermen, designed to provide post‑matric educational assistance through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). It has evolved from e‑Grantz 3.0 into the upgraded e‑Grantz 4.0, which is mandatory for applications from the 2025‑26 academic year onwards.
scholarships.name: Fisheriers E-Grantz Scholarship

scholarships.description: e‑Grantz is Kerala’s unified scholarship portal that provides pre‑matric and post‑matric financial assistance to students belonging to SC, ST, OBC, SBC, EBC, and OEC categories. It has been upgraded to e‑Grantz 4.0, which is Aadhaar‑linked and offers faster, transparent disbursement through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
scholarships.name: E-Grantz 4.0

scholarships.description: The Federal Bank Hormis Memorial Foundation Scholarship 2026 is one of the most generous CSR scholarships in India, offering 100% tuition fee reimbursement plus device support for first‑year students admitted under merit to professional courses.
scholarships.name: Federal Bank Hormis Memorial Scholarship

scholarships.description:
The Legrand Empowering Scholarship Program 2026–27 is a CSR initiative by Group Legrand India that supports meritorious girl students across India pursuing undergraduate degrees in engineering, architecture, science, commerce, and business. It is one of the most inclusive scholarships, offering higher benefits to students from special categories.

Must have secured admission in B.Tech., B.E., B.Arch., B.B.A., B.Com., or B.Sc. degrees.
Must have passed Class 12 in the academic year 2024–25.
Must have scored 70% or above in both Class 10 and 12.
Annual family income must be less than or equal to ₹5,00,000.

Must have secured admission in B.Tech., B.E., B.Arch., B.B.A., B.Com., or B.Sc. degrees.
Must have passed Class 12 in the academic year 2024–25.
Must have scored at least 60% in both Class 10 and 12. (Relaxation may be given on a case-by-case basis.)
Annual family income must be less than or equal to ₹5,00,000.
scholarships.name: Legrands Scholarship

scholarships.description: The Tata Capital Pankh Scholarship 2026–27 is a CSR initiative by Tata Capital Limited to support economically weaker students across India in pursuing higher education. It provides financial assistance ranging from ₹10,000 to ₹50,000 per year, depending on the level of study.
scholarships.minMarks: At least 60% marks in the preceeding academic year
scholarships.name: TATA Capital Pankh Scholarship

scholarships.description: The Aadhar Kaushal Scholarship 2025–26, run by Aadhar Housing Finance Ltd (AHFL), is a CSR initiative that supports students with physical disabilities pursuing undergraduate courses across India. It provides financial aid between ₹10,000 and ₹50,000, depending on actual college fees, with applications open until 13 January 2026 via the Buddy4Study portal.
scholarships.minMarks: At least 60% marks in the previous academic year
scholarships.name: Aadhar Kaushal Scholarship

scholarships.description: The L’Oréal India For Young Women in Science Scholarship 2026–27 is a flagship CSR program by L’Oréal India that empowers academically talented but financially challenged young women to pursue higher education in science. It has been running since 2003 and has supported over 500 scholars across India.
scholarships.minMarks: 85% in class 12 (science stream) for ug students , 60% in UG course for Pg, PhD students
scholarships.name: L'oreal India Scholarship

scholarships.description: The Swami Dayanand India Scholarship 2026–27 provides up to ₹50,000 per year to academically brilliant but financially underprivileged students pursuing professional degrees in engineering, medicine, pharmacy, IT, and architecture in India. Applications are open only to first‑year students admitted under merit quota, with 30% of awards reserved for girls.
scholarships.name: Swami Dayanand India Scholarship

scholarships.description: The U-Go Scholarship is a financial grant program designed to empower young women from low-income backgrounds pursuing professional undergraduate degrees. Selected scholars receive between INR 40,000 and INR 60,000 per year to cover tuition, books, hostel fees, and living expenses.
scholarships.name: U-GO Scholarship

scholarships.description: The DXC Progressing Minds Scholarship 2026–27 offers a one‑time grant of ₹50,000 to women and transgender students pursuing STEM undergraduate courses in India, with preference given to students with disabilities. Applications are open nationwide via Buddy4Study, with eligibility requiring ≥60% marks and annual family income ≤ ₹4 lakh.
scholarships.name: DXC Progressing Mind Scholarship

scholarships.description: The Amazon Future Engineer (AFE) Scholarship 2026–27 is a flagship CSR initiative by Amazon India to support first‑year girl engineering students from economically weaker backgrounds. It combines financial aid with mentorship and internship opportunities, making it one of the most holistic scholarships for tech aspirants.
scholarships.name: Amazon Future Engineer's Scholarship

scholarships.description:
Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12.
Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), Integrated BS-MS/BS-Research, in ISER, IISC(Bangalore), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree)
scholarships.name: Kotak Kanya Scholarship

scholarships.description: The Infosys Foundation STEM Stars Scholarship supports female Indian students pursuing undergraduate STEM degrees, offering up to ₹1 lakh annually to cover tuition, living expenses, and study materials. It is available to first-year students and select second-year/integrated degree students at reputed, NIRF-accredited institutions.
scholarships.name: Infosys Stem Star Scholarship

scholarships.description: The Priyadarshni Academy Scholarship 2026 is a merit‑cum‑need based program that supports bright students in India pursuing professional and academic degrees such as Engineering, Medicine, IT, Architecture, Management, Arts, Humanities, Social Sciences, Law, and B.Ed. The last date to apply is 31 December 2025, and applicants must have completed their first year with distinction and family income below ₹4 lakh per annum.
scholarships.name: Priyadarshini Scholarship

scholarships.description: The Virtusa Engineering Excellence Scholarship is a CSR initiative by the Virtusa Foundation that provides a one-time financial grant of INR 50,000 to outstanding, economically disadvantaged students pursuing B.Tech or B.E. degrees across India.
scholarships.name: Virtusa Engineering Scholarship

scholarships.description: The North South Foundation (NSF) Scholarship 2026 in India provides annual financial aid to meritorious but economically disadvantaged students pursuing professional undergraduate courses such as Engineering, Medicine, Agriculture, Nursing, Pharmacy, and Polytechnic. Awards range from ₹45,000 to ₹1.5 lakh depending on the course, and support continues until graduation if academic performance is maintained.
scholarships.name: North South Foundation Scholarship

scholarships.description: The StockGro Big Dream Scholarship is a financial grant program designed to help students fund their undergraduate or postgraduate studies, professional finance exams, and college tuition. The program awards successful applicants up to ₹50,000 directly to support their educational expenses.
scholarships.name: STOCKGRO Big Dream Scholarship

scholarships.description: The AICTE YASHASVI Scholarship 2026–27 provides up to ₹50,000 per year for engineering degree students and ₹30,000 per year for diploma students in AICTE‑approved institutions, aimed at supporting talented students from families with annual income below ₹8 lakh. Applications are open online via the National Scholarship Portal and AICTE’s YASHASVI portal.
scholarships.minMarks: At least 60% marks in the previous academic year
scholarships.name: AICTE Yashasvi Scholarship

scholarships.description: The C.H. Mohammed Koya Scholarship is a Kerala government initiative designed to support Muslim girl students pursuing higher education. It is one of the most important minority scholarships in the state, named after former Kerala Chief Minister C.H. Mohammed Koya.
scholarships.minMarks: At least 50% marks in the previous academic year
scholarships.name: CH Mohammed Koya Scholarship

scholarships.description: The Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS) is a Government of India program that provides annual financial support of ₹12,000 at the undergraduate level and ₹20,000 at the postgraduate level to Class 12 board exam toppers from families earning less than ₹8 lakh per year, helping them pursue regular degree courses in recognized colleges and universities through the National Scholarship Portal.
scholarships.name: Central Sector Scholarship

scholarships.description: The Muthoot M George Higher Education Scholarship 2025–26 is a CSR initiative of the Muthoot M George Foundation that supports meritorious students in Medicine, Engineering, and Nursing with sustained financial assistance for the full duration of their course. In its 9th edition, the program is funding 210 students across seven states with a total outlay of ₹3.36 crore.
scholarships.name: Muthoot M George Foundation Scholarship

scholarships.description: The NTPC Scholarship Scheme is a prestigious initiative by NTPC Limited designed to support meritorious students from economically and socially marginalized backgrounds. It provides financial assistance to SC, ST, and Persons with Disabilities (PwD) students pursuing full-time engineering degrees, offering a monthly stipend of ₹1,500.
scholarships.name: NTPC Scholarship

scholarships.description: The District Merit Scholarship (DMS) is a Government of Kerala initiative aimed at supporting meritorious students pursuing Higher Secondary, VHSC, ITI, or Polytechnic courses. Eligible students receive an annual financial reward of up to INR 2,000.
scholarships.name: District Merit Scholarship

scholarships.description: Snehapoorvam is a compassionate welfare scheme by the Kerala Social Security Mission (KSSM). It provides vital financial assistance to orphaned and vulnerable children who have lost one or both parents. The program enables these children to continue their education and living within their families and communities rather than in orphanages.
scholarships.name: Snehapoorvam Scholarship

private.description: The L’Oréal India For Young Women in Science Scholarship 2026–27 is a flagship CSR program by L’Oréal India that empowers academically talented but financially challenged young women to pursue higher education in science. It has been running since 2003 and has supported over 500 scholars across India.
private.minMarks: 85% in class 12 (science stream) for ug students , 60% in UG course for Pg, PhD students
private.name: L'oreal India Scholarship

private.description: The Swami Dayanand India Scholarship 2026–27 provides up to ₹50,000 per year to academically brilliant but financially underprivileged students pursuing professional degrees in engineering, medicine, pharmacy, IT, and architecture in India. Applications are open only to first‑year students admitted under merit quota, with 30% of awards reserved for girls.
private.name: Swami Dayanand India Scholarship

private.description: The U-Go Scholarship is a financial grant program designed to empower young women from low-income backgrounds pursuing professional undergraduate degrees. Selected scholars receive between INR 40,000 and INR 60,000 per year to cover tuition, books, hostel fees, and living expenses.
private.name: U-GO Scholarship

private.description: The DXC Progressing Minds Scholarship 2026–27 offers a one‑time grant of ₹50,000 to women and transgender students pursuing STEM undergraduate courses in India, with preference given to students with disabilities. Applications are open nationwide via Buddy4Study, with eligibility requiring ≥60% marks and annual family income ≤ ₹4 lakh.
private.name: DXC Progressing Mind Scholarship

private.description: The Amazon Future Engineer (AFE) Scholarship 2026–27 is a flagship CSR initiative by Amazon India to support first‑year girl engineering students from economically weaker backgrounds. It combines financial aid with mentorship and internship opportunities, making it one of the most holistic scholarships for tech aspirants.
private.name: Amazon Future Engineer's Scholarship

private.description:
Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12.
Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), Integrated BS-MS/BS-Research, in ISER, IISC(Bangalore), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree)
private.name: Kotak Kanya Scholarship

private.description: The Infosys Foundation STEM Stars Scholarship supports female Indian students pursuing undergraduate STEM degrees, offering up to ₹1 lakh annually to cover tuition, living expenses, and study materials. It is available to first-year students and select second-year/integrated degree students at reputed, NIRF-accredited institutions.
private.name: Infosys Stem Star Scholarship

private.description: The Priyadarshni Academy Scholarship 2026 is a merit‑cum‑need based program that supports bright students in India pursuing professional and academic degrees such as Engineering, Medicine, IT, Architecture, Management, Arts, Humanities, Social Sciences, Law, and B.Ed. The last date to apply is 31 December 2025, and applicants must have completed their first year with distinction and family income below ₹4 lakh per annum.
private.name: Priyadarshini Scholarship

private.description: The Virtusa Engineering Excellence Scholarship is a CSR initiative by the Virtusa Foundation that provides a one-time financial grant of INR 50,000 to outstanding, economically disadvantaged students pursuing B.Tech or B.E. degrees across India.
private.name: Virtusa Engineering Scholarship

private.description: The North South Foundation (NSF) Scholarship 2026 in India provides annual financial aid to meritorious but economically disadvantaged students pursuing professional undergraduate courses such as Engineering, Medicine, Agriculture, Nursing, Pharmacy, and Polytechnic. Awards range from ₹45,000 to ₹1.5 lakh depending on the course, and support continues until graduation if academic performance is maintained.
private.name: North South Foundation Scholarship

private.description: The StockGro Big Dream Scholarship is a financial grant program designed to help students fund their undergraduate or postgraduate studies, professional finance exams, and college tuition. The program awards successful applicants up to ₹50,000 directly to support their educational expenses.
private.name: STOCKGRO Big Dream Scholarship

private.description: The Muthoot M George Higher Education Scholarship 2025–26 is a CSR initiative of the Muthoot M George Foundation that supports meritorious students in Medicine, Engineering, and Nursing with sustained financial assistance for the full duration of their course. In its 9th edition, the program is funding 210 students across seven states with a total outlay of ₹3.36 crore.
private.name: Muthoot M George Foundation Scholarship

government_private.description: The LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship is a merit-cum-means scheme launched by the Life Insurance Corporation of India to support students from economically weaker sections (EWS) in continuing their education after Class 10 or 12. It aims to reduce financial barriers and encourage higher education in fields such as Medical, Engineering, General Graduation, Diploma, ITI, and Vocational courses
government_private.name: LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship

government_private.description: A prestigious, merit-based scholarship offered by the R.P. Foundation in partnership with NORKA Roots, providing significant financial assistance and long-term academic support to economically disadvantaged students pursuing higher education.
government_private.name: Ravi pillai Foundation (Norka Roots) Scholarship

cetaa.minMarks: No criteria of marks (Generally recommended by staff advisor)
cetaa.name: CEETAT Scholarship

cetaa.description: The MACEAA HOPE Plus Scholarship 2025–26, offered by the MACEA Galaxy Charitable Trust, provides up to ₹40,000 per year to financially challenged but academically strong students of the College of Engineering Trivandrum (MACE). Applications are open for 1st-year B.Tech and B.Arch students
cetaa.name: MACEAA Hope Plus Scholarship

cetaa.description: The MACEAA GEMS (Growing Engineers’ Monetary Support) Scholarship 2026 is offered by the College of Engineering Trivandrum Alumni Association (MACEAA) to support financially needy but meritorious students. It provides ₹10,000 per year
cetaa.name: MACEAA GEMS Scholarship
